title: Stabilizers — Trimmable Horizontal Stabiliser Front Spar — Forged Attachment Fitting Retrofit
abstract: Retrofit of the forged trimmable horizontal stabiliser front spar attachment on ZEPHYR-24 aircraft, moving the inspection threshold from 24000 to 40000 flight cycles and removing the need to strip the aft cabin for access.

sections.planning_reason: The built-up front spar attachment of the ZEPHYR-24 trimmable horizontal stabiliser reaches its reserve factor limit at around 68000 flight cycles under the extended-range load spectrum, short of the design service goal now claimed for the type. Its inspection also requires the aft fuselage to be opened, which operators only do at a heavy check. Operators intending to run their ZEPHYR-24 aircraft beyond 60000 cycles need the forged standard to keep the airframe life claim, and they gain a simpler inspection at the same time.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the built-up front spar attachment by a forged lug and a machined backing plate bolted through the existing fitting into the section 19 frame. The joint is shimmed with a liquid shim in place of laminated shims and the nut face washers are changed to a thicker corrosion-resistant item. The critical location moves from the fastener hole to the lug radius, which can be inspected without stripping the aft cabin.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Support the tailplane on trestles and de-rig the trim actuator. Get access through zones 331, 341 and 193 and remove the aft fuselage inspection panels. Remove the existing attachment bolts and the laminated shim pack. Do a detailed visual and eddy current inspection of the frame land and record every indication. Fit the fitting D5510127798904 with the forged lug CI558884-44 and the backing plate D5510122974242 dry, measure the gap and mix the liquid shim. Apply the liquid shim and close the joint within the pot life. Install the bolts with the washers AES722822-2A and torque in the sequence given on drawing D55101240925. Let the shim cure for the full period before removing the trestles. Re-rig the trim actuator, do the stabiliser travel check and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-24 aircraft in the MSN range Z02444 to Z11770, which is the block built before the forged attachment entered the production standard. It does not apply to ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20 or ZEPHYR-22 aircraft, whose tailplane attachment carries a different load spectrum and remains on the built-up fitting.
sections.material_note: Kit K5510-1015-01 contains the forged lug, the backing plate, the washer set and the liquid shim system for one aircraft. The forged lug is a long-lead item at thirty-two weeks. The liquid shim has a six-month shelf life and a two-hour pot life once mixed.

type_data.compliance_time: Before the accumulation of 40000 flight cycles for operators who intend to exceed the current life claim; otherwise at the operator's convenience.

abstract: Retrofit of the forged trimmable horizontal stabiliser front spar attachment on ZEPHYR-24 aircraft, re-issued with an effectivity written against accumulated flight cycles rather than against the serial number block.

sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all ZEPHYR-24 aircraft not built to the forged attachment standard, identified by accumulated flight cycles rather than by serial number. An aircraft is in the target population once it has passed 24000 accumulated flight cycles, or once its operator declares an intent to exceed the current life claim, whichever comes first. The original serial number block was drawn from build order and did not describe that population: short-sector aircraft reach the threshold a decade before long-sector aircraft of the same build, and several aircraft outside the block need the retrofit before several inside it. It does not apply to ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20 or ZEPHYR-22 aircraft, whose tailplane attachment carries a different load spectrum and remains on the built-up fitting.
sections.material_note: Kit K5510-1015-01 contains the forged lug, the backing plate, the washer set and the liquid shim system for one aircraft. The forged lug is a long-lead item at thirty-two weeks, so order against the projected cycle count rather than against the current one. The liquid shim has a six-month shelf life and a two-hour pot life once mixed.

type_data.compliance_time: Before the accumulation of 40000 flight cycles, and in any case before the operator exceeds the current life claim. Aircraft already beyond 24000 cycles should be slotted against the thirty-two week lug lead time.
